messages:
jordan: Quick thread to lock down customer comms and RCA access flow after the postmortem. Short answers please.
elaine: I can draft status page and 72h digest. ETA: Thu EOD for status copy, Fri AM for digest.
raj: I'll update the remediation tracker and add recurrence notes (past 90d). ETA: Tue AM.
maria: Legal prefers: public summary + RCA within 7 business days; full internal RCA shared on request under data addendum. I'll paste approved wording.
oliver: I'll prep templates for top customers (1:1) and general broadcast. Will align tone once status copy is ready.
support-bot: Support flow: request -> support@ -> ticket auto-tag incident-rca -> PSA routes to comms.
jordan: Elaine, please include a line about fallback/rollback used.
elaine: Draft status page (short):
""
Incident: intermittent inference failures for a subset of customers.
Impact: delayed or failed responses between 10:03-10:47 UTC.
Status: mitigated; fallback paths used.
Next steps: investigation ongoing; RCA expected within 7 business days.
""
raj: Noted. Added KV-cache patch row to tracker with owner=@raj due=2026-04-09 and verification plan. Also logged two prior similar incidents.
maria: I'll attach the addendum template to the postmortem doc and note request flow.
oliver: Outreach plan: personal note + offer for 30-min call for top 5; broadcast + link for others. Drafts Thur AM.
jordan: Action list: 1) Status page - elaine - Thu EOD. 2) 72h digest - elaine - Fri AM. 3) Remediation tracker + recurrence - raj - Tue AM. 4) RCA sharing text - maria - Wed EOB. 5) Outreach templates - oliver - Thu AM. 6) Support canned replies - support team - Thu EOD.
elaine: Posted draft to #incidents-drafts.
raj: Tracker link uploaded: https://drive.redwood/trackers/remediation-1976001234
support-bot: Reminder created for owners.
jordan: Thanks team. Ping me when drafts are live and I'll approve before we send to customers.
